name: Banish
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose a creature within Medium Range and roll Spirit vs Spirit. On a win, the creature is banished to a harmless demiplane. When the spell ends, the creature returns to the space it left, or the nearest unoccupied space.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the spell for 1 additional minute.

🌞: The spell does not require Concentration and lasts for 1 day.
